## Kyoto Weekend Weather Snapshot
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-sun.svg

A mild Kyoto weekend with the best outdoor window on **Saturday, 2026-11-07**. Sunday turns more variable, and Monday looks best kept flexible with a strong indoor plan.

## 3-Day Kyoto Itinerary by Forecast
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

| Date | Weather | Best plan | Indoor backup |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-07 | 19°C / 11°C, 10% rain, sunny | **Arashiyama + riverfront walk**; start early for clear views and comfortable temps | **Kyoto Railway Museum** |
| 2026-11-08 | 17°C / 10°C, 45% rain, partly cloudy | **Northern Kyoto temple circuit**; keep walks shorter and use taxis/buses between stops | **Kyoto International Manga Museum** |
| 2026-11-09 | 16°C / 9°C, 70% rain, overcast | **Indoor-first Higashiyama day** with only brief outdoor windows | **Nishiki Market + Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art** |

### Day 1: Best Outdoor Day — Arashiyama and the Katsura-side river walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg

- **Morning:** Go to **Arashiyama Bamboo Grove** early, then continue to **Tenryu-ji** before crowds build.
- **Afternoon:** Walk the **Togetsukyo Bridge** area and enjoy a slow lunch near the river.
- **Evening:** Keep dinner in central Kyoto so you can pivot if the weather shifts.
- **Indoor backup:** **Kyoto Railway Museum** for a strong weather-proof half-day.

### Day 2: Mixed Weather — Northern Kyoto temples with shorter transfers
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/umbrella.svg

- **Morning:** Visit **Kinkaku-ji** first; it photographs well even under thin cloud.
- **Afternoon:** Continue to **Ryoan-ji** or **Ninna-ji** depending on energy and rain timing.
- **Evening:** Choose a relaxed dinner in the city center and avoid overpacking the schedule.
- **Indoor backup:** **Kyoto International Manga Museum** if showers become more persistent.

### Day 3: Rain-Heavy Day — Indoor Kyoto with brief neighborhood walks
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg

- **Morning:** Start at **Nishiki Market** for food browsing and a covered stroll.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Morning:** Start at **Nishiki Market** for food browsing and a covered stroll, Kyoto, Japan
- **Afternoon:** Move to **Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art** or a nearby tea house for a longer indoor block.
- **Evening:** Keep the last stop near your hotel to minimize wet-weather transit.
- **Indoor backup:** Stay fully indoors and add a temple visit only if rain eases briefly.

## Best Garden Timing in Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/sun.svg

- **Best day:** **Saturday, 2026-11-07**
- **Best time:** **7:30 AM–10:00 AM JST**
- **Why:** Lowest rain risk, lighter wind, and softer morning light make gardens and temple grounds most enjoyable.
- **Best fit:** **Tenryu-ji garden**, **Ryoan-ji garden**, or a quieter stroll in **Arashiyama** before midday.
